decisions.reason: As a multi-model dietary supplement range with its own page and clear fit with the firm's stated portfolio expansion, management is likely to stay committed and view any early weakness as temporary.
This product is visible on the website, close to the consumer-health direction of the firm, and recent enough that management would likely justify continued support rather than withdraw it quickly.
Although less prominently presented than A or B, it still builds on the established offer and is close enough to the announced broadening of the portfolio that management is inclined to persist.

Its lower visibility and more niche positioning make it easier to discontinue than the other supplements, but escalation of commitment and the firm's expansion strategy still make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.

The launch-related problem raises the risk of withdrawal, yet in a large German pharmaceutical firm the regulatory, commercial, and reputational investments in a new generic would usually lead management to treat the setback as temporary and continue for now.
